title: Monthly options expiration (February 2027)
source: EST: cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement (302-redirects to /markets/us/futures/market-statistics/settlement/futures/daily; HTTP 200, 536,888 bytes with curl -L), fetched direct and parsed by this session on 2026-09-05 into 48 contract rows across 10 roots. Two independent routes on that one page reach this date. DIRECTLY: a live contract row rendered `"VA/G7", " - ", "2027-02-19"` — S&P 500 Variance futures, February 2027, final settlement 2027-02-19 — and across the 8 VA rows the page carries, the listed settlement equals the computed third Friday 7 times. BY THE 30-DAY RULE: `"VX/F7", " - ", "2027-01-20"`, and the VIX contract terms define final settlement against the SPX/SPXW series expiring exactly 30 days later, i.e. 2027-02-19; that rule reproduces on 8 of the 9 VX rows the page carries. The single exception in each list is the SAME exception and it validates the method: VA/M7 settles Thursday 2027-06-17 where June 2027's third Friday is 2027-06-18, and VX/K7 settles Tuesday 2027-05-18 instead of the usual Wednesday with +30 days landing on that same Thursday — both are Juneteenth observed on Friday 2027-06-18 pulling the expiration back a day. So the third-Friday convention is holiday-sensitive, Cboe's own table shows precisely where it breaks in 2027, and February is not where it breaks. This is a narrower and stronger sourcing than the sibling opex-2027-03-19 entry could claim, whose date is derived from a contract spec rather than listed. Filed estimate on two counts: this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and no expiration calendar was read directly — theocc.com returned HTTP 403 to a browser-UA curl from this runner again today (5,886 bytes, no calendar retrieved). PROMOTION CRITERION: fetch an OCC or Cboe expiration calendar that lists 2027-02-19 directly
notes: DISCOVERED during the japan-cpi-2027-02-19 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05). Before that sweep nothing tracked on this calendar sat within +/-5 days of 2027-02-19 and the whole of February 2027 held a single entry. Impact MEDIUM rather than the HIGH carried by opex-2027-03-19: this is an ordinary monthly expiration, not a quarterly triple witching — no index-futures leg, no Select Sector rebalance MOC. Two structural notes it is tracked for. (1) ATTRIBUTION: it shares its date with Japan's national January CPI print (japan-cpi-2027-02-19, estimate, 08:30 JST) — the same trap the March 2027 corridor carries one quarter earlier — so a 2027-02-19 US tape move has an expiration explanation available before it has a Japanese one. The two share a DATE and never a SESSION: 2027-02-19 falls in EST (US DST 2027 begins 2027-03-14), so 08:30 JST 2027-02-19 is 18:30 EST Thursday 2027-02-18, and Tokyo's only session to trade that print closes 8.5 hours before the US expiration session opens. (2) SHORT WEEK: US Presidents Day falls Monday 2027-02-15, so this is a four-session expiration week. The VIX/VXM February settlement two days earlier is tracked separately as vix-expiration-2027-02-17 (estimate, same fetched page). Registered as FT-japan-cpi-2027-02-19-3, score by 2027-02-22. INITIAL RESEARCH 2026-09-05 (docs/research/events/opex-2027-02-19.md) refined both notes above and added a third. The SHORT WEEK claim is true as a calendar-week statement and misleading as a pin-window one: counted mechanically, the last five sessions before this expiration are 2027-02-12, 02-16, 02-17, 02-18 and 02-19 — five, the same as any other cycle — so no session is lost. What changes is calendar SPAN: those five sessions cover 7 calendar days instead of the usual 4 (+75%), with all of the extra time inside one un-hedgeable Fri-to-Tue gap four sessions before expiry. The closure is now a calendar ENTRY rather than prose only (presidents-day-market-closure-2027-02-15, estimate, proposed in the same PR, NYSE-sourced), and it is not a seasonal regularity — the third Monday falls inside the third-Friday week in only 9 of the 21 Februaries 2015-2035 (43%). THE HOLIDAY CANNOT MOVE THIS DATE: the Cboe settlement page breaks the third-Friday convention exactly once across its whole 2026-09 to 2027-12 listing, and that break (VA/M7 2027-06-17, VX/K7 2027-05-18) is caused by Juneteenth observed on a FRIDAY, 2027-06-18; a Monday holiday is structurally incapable of producing it. THE FINDING THAT ACTUALLY DISTINGUISHES THIS EXPIRATION is Fed isolation, not the holiday: federalreserve.gov fetched 2026-09-05 lists no February 2027 meeting, and computing every 2027 third Friday against its nearest decision puts 2027-02-19 at 23 days (tied with 2027-08-20 for the 2027 maximum), 15 days clear of fomc-blackout-start-2027-03-06 — the inverse of opex-2027-03-19, which sits 2 sessions past the first SEP of 2027. Registered FT-opex-2027-02-19-1 (score by 2027-02-26), the first test of the PIN half of the pin/unpin literature here. Date stays estimate: theocc.com (403, both casings), the cdn.cboe.com 2027 expiration-calendar PDF (403), the Cboe expiration_calendar URL (404) and optionseducation.org (200 but zero 2027 rows) all failed, so no expiration CALENDAR was read directly; the PROMOTION CRITERION in the source field above is unchanged and unmet.
